Subject: Finlytics POC - recap + proposed MOP

Hi Evan / Natalie,

Great to meet today — quick recap and proposed plan so we’re all aligned. Thanks for the time and for walking through the evaluation goals.

High-level POC goal: validate that Redwood can meet Finlytics’ latency, throughput and accuracy needs for document-to-insights (extraction + classification) at scale while preserving data controls.

Success criteria (as discussed):
- Extraction accuracy: 95%+ entity recall on the provided sample set (Natalie to confirm final sample)
- Latency: 90th percentile generation latency <= 300ms for 1k token requests in our hosted eval, and <= 250ms in Dedicated profile (if requested)
- Throughput: sustain 25 reqs/sec with 300ms latency SLO during peak simulation
- Cost guidance: target cost per 1M tokens that keeps inference TCO within your threshold (we’ll produce ballpark estimates after first run)
- Security: data retention set to 30 days, KMS-managed keys, and SOC2 evidence provided (see attachments)

Evaluation plan / timeline (proposed):
- Week of Jun 8: environment setup, data ingest (sample set of ~500 documents), access provisioning, MOP sign-off
- Jun 10–19: run evaluation workloads (scheduling runs with stepwise increases in load), weekly check-in on Jun 15
- Jun 22: final results review and next-step decision meeting

Owners / asks: 
- Finlytics: provide final sample dataset and confirm PII redaction rules (Evan / Natalie)
- Redwood: provide MOP + eval checklist and set up eval environment (Marissa / Rishi)
- Procurement/Legal: sign off on MSA addendum if Dedicated capacity is requested (Procurement@finlytics.com)

Attached: finlytics-poc-mop-v1.pdf (detailed MOP), redwood-eval-checklist.xlsx (runbook + metrics)

Next steps: Please confirm the sample dataset by EOD Jun 4 so we can schedule environment build early next week. If the timeline looks off, tell me which dates work and we’ll adjust.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,

Thanks Marissa — this is great and aligned with our internal expectations. A few clarifications from our side:

- Dataset: we’ll deliver ~600 documents (mix of PDF bank statements, invoices and transaction logs). We’ll redact obvious PII but will leave entity context for model evaluation. Delivery ETA: Jun 4 EOD.
